row.notes: a generic VM node clear, not championship-specific (V100074; a maintainer rename to Vm_Node_Clear would fit): rcx unused, rdx = the node handle; a list node is emptied unless read-only, a set node is cleared through Ne_FlatHashSet_RemoveAllNotify, any other node through its vt+0x20; returns false for a read-only node. Game_CustomSeason_RebuildFromRounds clears the custom season's track list with it ([self+0x290]+0x298); a jmp into protected code, so the signature resolves that call
